title: Pharmacy · antibiotic course
text: Take 2 tablets after food, twice a day, for 5 days. Stop taking them and call us if you get a rash.

value.text: Stop taking them if you get a rash

presets.label: Everything right (Hinglish)
presets.text: do goli khane ke baad, subah shaam, paanch din. rash aaye to band kar dena

presets.label: 'oru week' and no rash warning (Manglish)
presets.text: randu gulika, food kazhinju, raavile vaikittu, oru week

presets.label: Does not stop on rash (Taglish)
presets.text: dalawang tableta pagkatapos kumain, dalawang beses, limang araw. kapag may rash, huwag itigil

title: Construction site · heat safety
text: Drink 1 bottle of water every hour. Take a 15-minute break in the shade at 12:30. If you feel dizzy, stop work and tell the supervisor.

value.text: Stop work if you feel dizzy

presets.label: Everything right (Hinglish)
presets.text: har ghante ek bottle paani, 12:30 par 15 minute break, chakkar aaye to kaam band kar dena

presets.label: 20-minute break (Taglish)
presets.text: kada oras isang bottle, 12:30 ng 20 minuto na break, kapag dizzy itigil ang trabaho

presets.label: Keeps working when dizzy (Arabizi)
presets.text: kul sa3a bottle wa7ed, 12:30 rest 15 daqiqa, law dokha la waqqif

title: Visa / HR · document checklist
text: Submit your passport copy and 2 photos by Thursday. The fee is 150 AED. Do not travel until your visa is stamped.

value.text: Do not travel until your visa is stamped

presets.label: Everything right (Hinglish)
presets.text: 2 photo aur guruvaar tak passport copy jama karna, fees 150 dirham, visa lagne tak safar mat karna

presets.label: Friday instead of Thursday (Arabizi)
presets.text: ithnain photo, youm al jum3a, 150 dirham, la safar

presets.label: 'Not 150 AED' (Taglish)
presets.text: dalawang photo, huwebes, hindi 150 AED, huwag bumiyahe

title: School circular · trip money
text: The school trip is on Monday. Send 30 AED and the signed form by Friday. Children must bring a water bottle.

presets.label: Everything right (Manglish)
presets.text: monday trip aanu. friday-kku 30 dirham um oru signed form um kodukkanam. oru water bottle konduvaranam

presets.label: 20 AED instead of 30 (Hinglish)
presets.text: trip somvaar ko hai, shukravaar tak 20 dirham aur ek form dena, ek bottle laana

presets.label: 'Don't bring a bottle' (Taglish)
presets.text: lunes ang trip, biyernes 30 dirham at isang form, huwag magdala ng isang bottle
